title: PGA rekod 11 kes kawat duri sempadan dipotong di Kelantan
summary: RANTAU PANJANG: Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) merekodkan 11 kes kawat duri dipotong di sepanjang sempadan Malaysia-Thailand di Kelantan antara 27 Mac hingga 12 Oktober lalu.

title: Pakistani shop owner arrested over 19-year Thai identity fraud
summary: A Pakistani shop owner was arrested in Pattani over Thai identity fraud dating to 2007, when he allegedly paid 100,000 baht for an ID.
